name: Kenco MCS Dallas III - Lancaster TX

fieldNotes.location: Roster gives identical APPROXIMATE coords (32.635612,-96.802949) for three Kenco Lancaster facilities (Dallas III/IV/II = 589,362 / 560,000 / 200,000 SF). They sit in the dense Danieldale Road multi-tenant logistics corridor in Lancaster TX 75134; confirmed Kenco anchor address 2821 Danieldale Rd (Indeed job posting + Bandana company directory). Per-building Kenco leasing is not publicly disambiguated, so idx 12 (largest, 589,362 SF = Dallas III) was assigned to the large cross-dock building whose west dock face the roster coordinate falls on (center ~32.6375,-96.8013).
fieldNotes.truckGate: Open speculative-park access drives - no barrier arm, no gate, no guard booth. Street View (2021-02) shows wide open paved entrance drives with only fire-lane striping.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth observed at any property entrance.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False - no truck gate present, so remote check-in does not apply.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock building with continuous dock banks on BOTH long faces (east and west) - shipping and receiving run from physically separate dock clusters.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Large dedicated trailer drop yards south of the building and along the dock aprons, with 100+ trailers parked in dense rows.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Cross-dock building ~330 m long with dock doors along both long faces; combined count well into the 50+ band. dockDoorCount ~110 is an overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: The Danieldale Road corridor is a large multi-building logistics park; Kenco itself occupies three buildings here. Marked true at the campus level.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved aprons and drives provide ample room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Multiple separate drive connections serve the property; estimated separate in/out points. Listed uncertain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Lancaster TX is a southern suburb within the Dallas-Fort Worth metro - dense industrial fabric. Urban.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters this building's property; rail lines in the wider corridor do not serve it.
fieldNotes.confidence: Medium - building-level identity within the three same-coord Kenco Lancaster facilities could not be confirmed from public data; audit reflects the large cross-dock building at the roster coordinate.
